title: “Parents, if you don’t talk first — TikTok will.”
paragraphs: “Parents, if you don’t talk first — TikTok will.”

Romans 12:2 – Do not conform to the pattern of this world.
→ Trends are not moral authority.

I need to say this calmly but clearly. There’s a so-called “Skull Breaker” prank circulating again in some schools — and it’s not funny, it’s dangerous. Kids are being pressured to join trends that can literally cause brain injury just for a few seconds of online attention. Mga anak natin are growing up in a world where clout feels more valuable than character. And that’s the real issue. The algorithm rewards shock, not wisdom. But listen — popularity fades. Injury lasts. Parents, talk to your children. Young people, please hear this from kuya level: your life is not content. Your head is not a punchline. “The prudent see danger and take refuge” (Proverbs 22:3). Hindi lahat ng uso, tama. Discernment is protection. Let’s raise a generation that chooses courage over clout.
